$comment: F6 kill montages (clip_montage.py, `clipper.py montage`): Shorts built from ALL own kills (kill-feed own-kill lines with signal true plus medal-inferred kills), streaks first (higher tier first), then the remaining single kills until the length target is met; more kills than fit make more montages (user 2026-11-08, D298 proposed; until then streak kills only). Short clips stay streak-only. Dead time between kills cut out, pieces from different matches joined; a streamer death stays a hard negative. Kill weights, minScore, sumKinds and the death rule come from data/clip/ranking.json (approved 2026-11-07). Values below chosen by the user 2026-11-07 (length 30-45 s inside 20-60 s, 3 s before and 1.5 s after each kill, hard cut with an 80 ms audio fade, matches may be joined); joinGapSec, chainGapSec, killDetectors, medalLeadSec and medalMatchSec set by the agent (proposed, unverified).
approved: user 2026-11-08: 'combine kills and make a montage. priority given to streaks of course.' (all own kills, streaks first, extra montages instead of dropping kills); user 2026-11-07: '30-45 s (Recommended)', '3 s before, 1.5 s after (Recommended)', 'Hard cut + audio fade (Recommended)', 'clips from different matches can be joined together'; user 2026-11-07 won-match reel: 'Every own kill (Recommended)', canvas 'V (Recommended)'

cl2.by: agent 2026-11-12 (triage F2, user: 'there was 2 kills before that which was not captured ... then it's boring long footage of streamer just running through the map')
cl2.evidence: session 2026-11-11 21:10 (BR match 1): B1 kill feed read no own kill in 300 hits (own name cut off in the V cutout); the own HUD text B2 read KNOCKED DOWN at 555, 561, 580 s and ELIMINATED at 560, 581 s (signal true), the 3X MULTI-KILL medal at 582 s; the medal's kills spanned 555-582 s (27 s), more than chainGapSec 12. 21 B2 hits in the session, all BR.
cl2.values: B2:ELIMINATED counts as an own kill; B2:KNOCKED DOWN is an action (shown, not counted); chain gap 30 s in BR (above the 21-27 s seen), 12 s elsewhere

notes.medalMatchSec: a medal counts as covered by an own-kill line no more than this before it; otherwise the medal is its own kill
notes.joinGapSec: two pieces closer than this stay one piece (the gap is kept, not cut)
notes.chainGapSec: kills and medals no more than this apart form one streak (same as live-clips quietSec)
notes.killDetectors: own-kill kill-feed lines (signal true); a streak medal with no own-kill line near it becomes a kill at medal t - medalLeadSec
notes.order: 2026-11-08: streak groups by score (best first), then single-kill groups (most kills first, then time); each group goes into the first montage with room up to targetMaxSec; shorts join inside maxSec; a montage left below minSec gives its groups to the others inside maxSec
notes.resultLeadSec: won-match reel (D237): the VICTORY screen piece starts this long before the W1 hit and ends resultHoldSec after its last frame (agent values, proposed)
